name: New Zealand
notes: Depth: seed plus broad follow-up. 59 supporters and 61 evidence records across national parties, individual politicians, campaigns, unions, economists, commentators, faith and business. Two named-list harvests completed; historical positions distinguished from current policy. Local sample only. All 67 territorial authorities (Stats NZ 2026) and 16 regions (2025), official codes, CC BY 4.0; cross-region authorities at country root. Unswept councils pending. Not saturated: see area_profile.md and R002 for gaps and priorities.

polls.scope: New Zealand adults aged 18 and over
polls.question: Do you support the introduction of a wealth tax: a 2.5% tax on an individual’s net assets above $10 million with an exemption for family homes?

polls.scope: New Zealand adults (national sample; sampling frame not stated in the release)
polls.question: Do you think there should be a tax that people pay on assets such as houses, cars and KiwiSaver accounts, additional to the existing income tax?
polls.commissioned_by: New Zealand Taxpayers' Union (an opponent of the tax)
